title: Chaotic Tweaks
description: Adds balanced woodcutting, interactions between cauldrons and dispensers, and more! Fully Server-Side!
body:
# What does this mod add/tweak?

## 1) Interactions between cauldrons and dispensers
**You can now use dispensers to automate the filling/emptying of your cauldrons!**
- An empty bucket will always empty any cauldron, but the cauldron has to be full if you want your bucket to be filled, otherwise it'll stay empty.
- A bucket with liquid will fill any cauldron, no matter what's already inside, it'll be replaced.
- A water bottle fills a cauldron with 1 level of water
- A glass bottle empties a cauldron by 1 level of water

## 2) Rebalancing some crafts
**Some crafts are pretty unbalanced in vanilla, so this mod changes how much they yields.**
- Buttons: 4 instead of 1
- Pressure Plates: 2 instead of 1
- Wooden Trapdoors: 6 instead of 2
- Metal Trapdoors: 4 instead of 1
- Wood: 4 instead of 3
- Stripped Wood: 4 instead of 3

## 3) Dropping some blocks without Silk Touch
**Some blocks will drop themselves without needing the Silk Touch enchantment.**
- Glass blocks
- Glass panes
- Clay blocks

## 4) Adding some QoL crafts
**All for your comfort. No need to thank me :3**
- Amethyst block can be uncrafted into 4 Amethyst Shards
- Nether Wart block can be uncrafted into 9 Nether Warts
- Clay block can be uncrafted into 4 Clay balls
- Green dye can be crafted with 1 Blue dye and 1 Yellow dye
- Rotten Flesh can be turned into Leather by cooking it in a Smoker or on a Campfire
- 2 identical slabs can be crafted together into their full block version
- Wool and Wool carpets gives respectively 4 and 2 Strings when put in the Stonecutter

## 5) Adding balanced Woodcutting
**The Stonecutter can now take care of wood! In a balanced way, not by letting you get all wood blocks for only 1 plank :p**
- 1 plank can be woodcutted into 2 Slabs OR 1 Stairs OR 1 Trapdoor
- 1 wooden door can be woodcutted into 2 Trapdoors
- 1 Log can be woodcutted into 1 Wood OR 1 Stripped Wood OR 1 Stripped Log
- 1 Wood can be woodcutted into 1 Stripped Wood

## 6) Showing Piglins how to respect your Armor Trims
**Piglins will now respect some of your Armor Trims, making you safe as if you were wearing a golden armor piece.**
- Piglins respect armor pieces trimmed with Gold
- Piglins respect armor pieces trimmed with the Snout pattern

*NOTE: Piglin Brutes will still be angry at you no matter what, and Piglins will still attack you if you're in their bastion, or open their chests, or mine gold.*

# Should I install this on client or server?
**This mod is fully server-side, however you can also install it on your client to use it on your solo worlds!**

# Is this mod compatible with other mods?
**Hopefully yes, I did my best to not break anything.**

# Is there a version for another mod loader/another Minecraft version?
**Currently this mod only supports Fabric and Minecraft 1.21.10. It may work with Quilt, but nothing guaranted. But I could eventually port it to other modloaders and Minecraft versions when I'll have more free time!**

# Can I use this mod in my modpack?
**Of course, I'd be really happy if you do! Just please credit me~**
